pack.title: Research content
pack.description: Risks and controls for research: funders and journals, analysis that must be reproducible, data shared under agreements, and work with collaborators.

risks.title: A funder's or journal's rule on AI is broken
risks.description: AI is used to write or review an application or a manuscript in a way the funder or journal forbids, and the work is rejected or withdrawn.
risks.treatment: Keep the rules of your main funders and journals where authors see them, and ask authors to confirm they were followed.

risks.title: An analysis that used AI cannot be run again
risks.description: A result depends on a model version, a prompt, or settings nobody recorded, and the model has since changed.
risks.treatment: Record the model, its version, the prompts, and the settings with the analysis, and keep the outputs that the result rests on.

risks.title: Unpublished findings reach a supplier
risks.description: Draft results, grant ideas, or data not yet published are entered into a tool whose supplier may keep or learn from them.
risks.treatment: Use tools whose terms forbid training on inputs for unpublished work, and say so in the catalog.

risks.title: A collaborator's institution has different rules
risks.description: Shared data or a shared model is used with a tool that one partner allows and another does not.
risks.treatment: Agree which tools may be used with shared material at the start of a collaboration, and write it into the agreement.

risks.title: Research participants were not told AI would be used
risks.description: Participants' data is processed by AI in a way the consent form and the approved protocol do not describe.
risks.treatment: Check each use against the consent form and the protocol, and amend them before the use begins.

risks.title: Generated data is mistaken for observed data
risks.description: Synthetic or imputed values produced by a model are mixed with measurements and later analyzed as if they were observed.
risks.treatment: Label generated data at the point it is made and keep it apart from observed data.

control_categories.label: Keep data where it may be

controls.title: Funders' and journals' rules on AI are kept current
controls.statement: The rules on AI of the funders and journals the organization works with most are collected, dated, and shown to authors.

controls.title: The model, prompts, and settings behind a result are recorded
controls.statement: For research output that depends on AI, the model and version, the prompts, and the settings are kept with the analysis.

controls.title: The approved protocol and consent cover the use
controls.statement: Where human-subjects data is involved, the protocol and the consent form describe this use of AI, or have been amended to.

controls.title: Generated data is labelled and kept apart
controls.statement: Synthetic and imputed data is marked as such where it is stored and in anything published from it.
